# Year

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A calendar year grouping quarters and months.

## Scope note

Contains lower-level time horizons via IN_YAR: anchor for annual planning and retrospectives.

## Broader

- [Calendar](../Calendar/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
